verdict.rationale: Cal.com exposes an explicitly versioned API: the docs are organized under API v2 and endpoints are versioned paths such as POST /v2/bookings. The introduction also labels the Platform auth method as "Deprecated", which shows deprecations are flagged in the docs. But nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, such as timelines, sunset notices or version-pinning guarantees. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy or sunset timeline, versioning/changelog semantics (e.g. version headers or pinning), and independent corroboration of stability practices.
